description:
Render an existing invoice as a print-ready PDF and attach it as the invoice's source document. The invoice shortcut of well_generate_document: it prints the invoice in its own chosen design, ink and locale. Use well_generate_document instead to choose another design or to print values that are not an invoice in Well.

The letterhead carries the issuing company's own mark when Well has one on
file, and otherwise sets the issuer's name as text. Never promise a logo.

Use this tool when the user asks to generate, render, or attach a PDF for an
invoice that already exists in the workspace. This does NOT email or send the
invoice anywhere — it only creates and attaches the file. A request to email or
send an invoice is not a request for its PDF: do not call this tool for it.

REQUIRED: invoice_id (the invoice must already exist)

Refused if the invoice is already linked to a REAL ingested document (an
upload, a connector import, or a provider-issued PDF) — that source of truth
is never overwritten.

Returns { success: true, invoice_id, document_id, reference_number, file } on
success, or { success: false, error } on failure.

`file` carries the rendered PDF's name and size plus the links to fetch it.
Hand the user `download_url` when they ask for the PDF itself.
- `download_url` saves the PDF and `signed_url` opens it in a browser. Both
  work with a plain HTTP GET and no auth header, and stop working at `expires_at`.
- `preview_url` is a PNG image of the first page, for showing the document;
  add `page=N` for page N, up to `page_count`. Same token and expiry.
- `sheet_url` is the document's HTML sheet, which the card draws with zoom
  and pan. Same token and expiry.
- When the user wants to do more with a PDF already generated (attach it to an
  email, upload it elsewhere, read or analyse it), fetch `download_url` with a plain HTTP GET.
- If the links have expired, call this tool again to refresh the same document and its links.
- `app_url` opens the document in Well and never expires.
- The links grant access to the file on their own: share them only with the user.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A retried write with the same key returns the original result instead of re-applying the operation.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several — a write lands in exactly one workspace and this call would not say which.

name: well_create_invoice_document

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

page_count.description: How many pages the PDF prints.

preview_url.description: A PNG image of the PDF's first page, for showing the document. Add page=N for page N.

sheet_url.description: The document's HTML sheet, for a viewer that draws the document itself instead of showing the PDF.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. Start the reply with one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.
